in_sanskrit.name: क्रति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: क्रतिः (kratih) is a Sanskrit word meaning power, strength, will, ability, authority. It is derived from the root verb क्रत् (kratah), which means to do, make, produce, accomplish, or establish. The suffix -ि (i) denotes a feminine gender. Thus, Krati is a feminine name meaning one who possesses great power or strength.

in_hindi.name: क्रति
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Krati is transliterated as क्रति (kratī), and it has the same meaning as in Sanskrit - power, strength, will, ability, authority. The Hindi word for power is शक्ति (śakti).

in_tamil.name: க்ரடி
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Krati is transliterated as க்ரடி (kraṭi), and its meaning is derived from the Tamil word க்ருதி (kruḻi), which means power, strength, ability, or authority. The name Krati thus means one who possesses great power or strength.

in_telugu.name: క్రతి
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Krati is transliterated as క్రతి (kratī), and it has the same meaning as in Sanskrit - power, strength, will, ability, authority. The Telugu word for power is శక్తి (śakti).

in_marathi.name: Krati
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Krati is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kratu', which means 'power' or 'control'. In Hindu mythology, Krati is a feminine name associated with the goddess Kali, symbolizing the ultimate power and destructive force in the universe.
